similarOrganizations.name: Coura
similarOrganizations.description:
Coura is a founder product strategy studio for first-time, non-technical software founders.

We help founders make clearer product, positioning, go-to-market, and fundraising decisions before they build, so they can move forward with more confidence, protect the integrity of their vision, and avoid costly early mistakes.

Our clients are often domain experts, experienced operators, and underrepresented founders, translating deep expertise into a technology product for the first time. They understand the problem they're trying to solve, but what they need is strategic guidance on what to build first, what to leave out, how to position the product clearly, and how to align product, go-to-market, and fundraising decisions early.

Our work helps founders define a focused MVP, sharpen the value proposition, evaluate roadmap trade-offs, assess traction after the MVP, and strengthen the narrative behind the business.

Coura’s work is advisory-led and discovery-first. In select cases, founders can continue working with us through a limited number of product-build partnerships.

If you are building your first software product and want to make smarter decisions before development begins, Coura was built for you.

AI is changing education, but who’s protecting the data behind it?

At FLAsia 2026 in Singapore, one message stood out: as education franchisors increasingly adopt generative AI, data protection can no longer be an afterthought. With student, parent, franchisee, and financial data moving across locations and jurisdictions, organizations need to understand where their data goes and who remains responsible for it. Our latest blog explores the evolving data protection landscape and how education businesses can adopt AI while keeping sensitive data secure and under control.

Read the full blog: https://lnkd.in/ggZ4DUMc
